description: Defines the WindowsSystemProxyResolutionRequest class, which manages an asynchronous proxy resolution request on Windows within Chromium's network proxy resolution system.

classes.name: WindowsSystemProxyResolutionRequest
classes.description: Manages a single asynchronous proxy resolution request for Windows in Chromium.

methods.name: WindowsSystemProxyResolutionRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the proxy resolution request with necessary parameters.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the current load state of the request.

methods.name: ProxyResolutionComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of proxy resolution, providing proxy list and status.

methods.name: GetProxyResolutionRequestForTesting
methods.description: Returns internal proxy resolution request for testing purposes.

methods.name: ResetProxyResolutionRequestForTesting
methods.description: Resets internal proxy resolution request for testing.

methods.name: CancelResolveRequest
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing proxy resolution request.

methods.name: was_completed
methods.description: Checks if the request has been completed.
